patent_title: Chloroprene copolymer latex and production method therefor
emulsifier: disproportionated rosin acid (65 g), sodium salt of a β-naphthalenesulfonic acid-formalin condensate (3.3 g), potassium hydroxide (17.1 g), sodium hydroxide (3.9 g)
reaction_time: until polymerization conversion of all the monomers reached 84% by mass
coagulation: steam distillation to remove unreacted monomers
polymer_properties: tetrahydrofuran insoluble content, weight average molecular weight (Mw), monomer unit content in chloroprene copolymer
experimental_notes: polymerization conducted under a nitrogen gas atmosphere, emulsion polymerization
